name: lr_schedule_20260812
status: declared experiment launched; dicos-f-01 training, no result yet and none claimed

finding.summary: calibrated_lr3e4's cosine schedule has been annealing over 6 epochs, not the horizon each config declared, for the entire project.
finding.mechanism: checkpoint.py:75 restores scheduler_state unconditionally on every resume, and T_max is part of a CosineAnnealingLR state dict. An ancestor's 6-epoch horizon therefore propagated into every continuation of this family regardless of the horizon each new config declared. No config was hand-edited; the value was inherited.

confirmation_not_inference.note: the trainer records the realised per-epoch learning rate, so the period is read off the record rather than deduced from the loss

loss_tracks_lr_phase.interpretation: the model is genuinely learning about 0.04 per 12-epoch cycle, but each cycle re-heats to the full 3e-4 peak and gives most of it back. Every recorded best for this family is whichever trough happened to be deepest.

false_stop.recorded_reason: best epoch 47 (4.512721) is 7 epochs behind the latest epoch 54 and no family remains in the chain
false_stop.why_it_is_an_artifact: epoch 54 sat mid-descent at lr 2.25e-4 with the next trough due near epoch 58. An improvement window shorter than the learning-rate period measures where in the cycle a segment stopped, not whether the family converged.
false_stop.same_class: dicos-p8 was stopped by a constant patience at 6 of 24 epochs, i.e. before reaching the low-LR end of its own anneal

finding.reframes_a_standing_note: CLAUDE.md records that a scheduler restart 'produced nothing' where continuing produced dicos-p9's 0.067. That comparison is confounded: the restart run was ended early by patience and never reached the part of the anneal under test. It is not evidence against restarting with patience equal to the horizon.

declared_change.mechanism: routes through trainer._restart_cosine_scheduler, which rebuilds CosineAnnealingLR with T_max = updates_per_epoch * (epochs - start_epoch) -- this segment's own horizon -- giving one 24-epoch anneal instead of four 6-epoch sawteeth

improvement_window.why: at least one full former LR period, so the stopping rule cannot fire on phase

patience.why: equals the horizon; the anneal's low-LR end is the part under test and patience must not end the run before it

declared_change.comparability: DECLARED EXPERIMENT -- segments frozen under this campaign are not directly comparable to any frozen before it
declared_change.guard_note: no guard was weakened. training.restart_scheduler_on_resume was already inside ALLOWED_CONFIG_DELTA; dicos_campaign.py merely hardcoded False. It is now campaign.get('restart_scheduler_on_resume', False), so every earlier campaign means exactly what it meant.

verified_live.producer_note: a second pid appeared in one /proc scan and was gone on re-check -- a transient child, not a second writer; rule 24 holds

watcher.note: reclaimed a stale lock from dead pid 24900

expectation.early_epochs: expected WORSE than 4.512721 -- the restart re-heats to 3e-4 from a checkpoint annealed to 2.1e-5. That is the same jump the sawtooth performed every 12 epochs; the difference is the descent now has 24 epochs rather than 6.
expectation.tests_exactly_one_thing: whether annealing once over the declared horizon reaches a lower validation loss than the sawtooth's 4.512721
expectation.negative_result_policy: a negative result is a real result and will be reported in full with the complete trajectory

operational_note.symptom: python scripts/dicos.py exec "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib64 …" fails locally with 'Files/Git/usr/lib64: No such file or directory' and never reaches the pod
operational_note.cause: MSYS path conversion rewrites /usr/lib64 to C:/Program Files/Git/usr/lib64; the space splits the argument
operational_note.resolution: the prefix is unnecessary for the supervisor -- launch() sets LD_LIBRARY_PATH for the trainer subprocess and the supervisor is CPU-only. Keep it only for a direct one-off .venv/bin/python -c that needs CUDA, where the whole command is a single quoted argument and survives.

verification.dry_run: allowed delta fields only; training.learning_rate absent

still_open.publication_owed: calibrated_lr3e4's lowest verified loss changed to 4.512721 (dicos-e-02 e47) while the live public selection is still dicos-p9-calibrated-lr1e4:joint:0038. Deliberately not made here; dicos-f-01 may move the number again within a day.
still_open.other_families: if annealing over the real horizon helps, the same question should be asked of calibrated_lr1e4_halfbatch and calibrated_lr3e5 as a separate declared campaign rather than folded into this one.
